summary: Second consecutive near-silent week, and this one is worse than it looks: 7 messages, and 100% of them were about the invoice. ALTR's only outbound contact all week was Stephski's Aug 1-14 invoice on Aug 15 plus the attached PDF - no Derrek, no Mica reel inspo (first skipped week after Jul 29 and Aug 13 drops), no follow-up on the OnlyFans flag. Liza carried the entire client side herself and, importantly, she paid without being chased: on Aug 19, four days after the invoice, she confirmed 'I sent two wires from the same name as last time. One for 5.000$ and another for the rest 2.433$', posted three screenshots, then corrected herself with 'Actually it's 3 wires sorry'. As of the end of the window nobody at ALTR had replied to confirm the money landed - two days of silence on a split third-party wire that was sent into a bank account number Stephski changed in that very same invoice message ('Please note an update to the account number'). That is the exact setup that produced the '$1201 remaining' phantom shortfall on Jul 27 and the $200 short on Jul 14. Meanwhile the two things she was actually promised remain undelivered: Derrek's 'plenty of updates starting next week' on the $40k Phone Farm / IG rebuild (promised Aug 1 for the week of Aug 9, now 13 days past the promised window with zero Derrek messages since Aug 4), and Ronnie's 'will keep an eye if it happens again will look more into it' on the OF tag-a-creator flag (12 days, never reported back). The relationship has now fully narrowed to billing: she pays on time, and gets an invoice in return.

health.rationale: Down from 70. The client did the right thing - paid the Aug 1-14 invoice unprompted within 4 days - but ALTR's entire outbound for the week was one invoice and one PDF. Derrek's Aug 1 Phone Farm update is now 13 days past its promised window with no owner contact since Aug 4, Ronnie's OF-flag investigation commitment aged to 12 days with no report-back, Mica skipped the weekly reel inspo for the first time in three cycles, and her split third-party wire into a newly-changed account number sat unacknowledged for the last 2 days of the window. Two straight weeks where the only proactive touch is an invoice is a churn pattern, not a quiet patch.
